Earlier reports indicated that WhatsApp was developing a new chat room theme feature, which has now been officially rolled out to iPhone users. Here are the details.

WhatsApp's new chat room theme feature introduces dynamic backgrounds

According to WABetaInfo, WhatsApp is rolling out five categories of chat room themes in batches: "Featured", "Nature", "Dynamic", "Minimalist", and "Doodle". Two weeks ago, the website had already spotted clues about the new theme series in the code.

The website stated that the "Featured" category includes "the best themes carefully selected by the WhatsApp design team"; the "Nature" category "brings outdoor scenery into the chat room interface"; the "Dynamic" category offers "wallpapers that move slowly in the background"; the "Minimalist" theme "pairs solid color backgrounds with the chat room interface: white for light mode and black for dark mode"; as for "Doodle", it includes WhatsApp's classic doodle-pattern wallpapers.

Below is WABetaInfo's introduction to the "Dynamic" wallpapers, arguably the most noteworthy feature this time:

WABetaInfo pointed out that WhatsApp will automatically match the corresponding chat bubble colors based on the selected theme, and added that, as is WhatsApp's usual practice, the new feature may not be immediately available to all users.
